name: Sports
description: Sports word search puzzles with a grown-up pace. These free online grids cover classic athletic vocabulary — courts, pitches, trails and quiet training mornings — without team logos or branded names. Choose easy, medium or hard difficulty and play at your own speed. Words can run across, down and, on harder grids, diagonally or backwards. There is no timer and nothing to download. A solid choice when you want a focused puzzle that feels familiar without the noise of live scores.
